phases.speaker: caelan
phases.text: *slows beside the torn bank* That tree’s come down across the water.

phases.speaker: mira
phases.text: And look at the bark. Those gouges are fresh.

phases.speaker: mira
phases.text: *her expression tightens* I see it. Stay with me.

phases.speaker: mira
phases.text: It must have. Look at its tusks. A broken limb from that tree would explain the intake.

phases.speaker: caelan
phases.text: *sets down the tool roll* It’s seen us.

phases.speaker: mira
phases.text: Caelan, come back to me. Slowly. Keep your feet under you.
